description: Header file defining the ElfMemImage class and related structures for in-memory ELF image handling, including symbol lookup and iteration.

classes.name: ElfMemImage
classes.description: Represents an in-memory ELF image with symbol lookup and iteration capabilities.

classes.name: SymbolInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a single ELF symbol, including name, version, address, and symbol table entry.

classes.name: SymbolIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing symbols within the ElfMemImage.

methods.name: ElfMemImage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ELF image from a base address.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes or reinitializes the ELF image with a base address.

methods.name: IsPresent
methods.description: Checks if the ELF header is valid and the image is present.

methods.name: GetPhdr
methods.description: Returns program header at specified index.

methods.name: GetDynsym
methods.description: Returns dynamic symbol at specified index.

methods.name: GetVersym
methods.description: Returns version symbol at specified index.

methods.name: GetVerdef
methods.description: Returns version definition at specified index.

methods.name: GetDynstr
methods.description: Returns dynamic string at given offset.

methods.name: GetSymAddr
methods.description: Returns the address of a symbol.

methods.name: GetVerstr
methods.description: Returns version string at given offset.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to beginning of symbols.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator to end of symbols.

methods.name: LookupSymbol
methods.description: Finds a symbol by name, version, and type.

methods.name: LookupSymbolByAddress
methods.description: Finds symbol info by memory address.
